title: AE40036: Non Linear Vibration In Aerospace Structures
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21004, AE31002, AE31005
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsPhase space, singular points, limit cycles;
analytic methods, perturbation techniques, equivalent linearization; Duffing s
equation, jump phenomenon, Van der Pol equation; Stability criteria; Floquet s
theory, Hill s and Mathieu s equations, Bifurcation and chaos; application in
aerospace continuous structures.
